notice: Research only. A simulated (paper) test of a fixed rule on live exchange prices. No orders are placed and no money is involved. Not a strategy recommendation, not financial advice. Do not use for trading.

forward.title: BTC/ETH 70/30 with a monthly reset, tested forward on live prices
forward.rule: Buy a fixed amount of BTC and ETH every day (70% / 30%). On the 1st of each month, sell what has run ahead and buy the laggard so the mix is back to 70/30. Compared with the same buys never rebalanced.
